title: GTA 6's Dre'Quan Priest: From Street Dealer to Record Label Boss 🎤 #Shorts
description:
Meet Dre'Quan Priest from GTA 6. Per Rockstar's official character page, he "was always more of a hustler than a gangster" — even while dealing on the streets, breaking into music was the goal. He's partnered with Boobie Ike on Only Raw Records, just signed Real Dimez, and is setting his sights on the Vice City scene. His quote: "Dancers are like my A&Rs. If the record's a hit, DJs gonna be spinnin' it."

Source: rockstargames.com/VI (Only in Leonida – Dre'Quan Priest). GTA 6 launches Nov 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
Images: official Rockstar Games screenshots.
